card.name: Inside drug names mid-spelling
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a long drug name, such as the IN in HERCEPTIN, the ab in trastuzumab, or the iaz in phenothiazine. It fires where the name is still unfinished and more letters must follow.

modes.label: Trastuzumab brand and generic
modes.description: Middle piece of HERCEPTIN HYLECTA or trastuzumab, mostly in cardiomyopathy warnings.
modes.example: Cardiomyopathy: HERCEPT<<IN>> HYLECTA can result in subclinical

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of other long drug names such as etomidate, doxorubicin and phenothiazine.

card.writes: It pushes toward drug-name word endings and away from shoreline and tide words, which suggests it mainly helps finish a name.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name, before the name is finished.
